title: Effects of ozanimod on myelin dynamics and neurodegeneration in patients with relapsingremitting multiple sclerosis: correlation with disease activity, cognition, fatigue,depression and quality of life
official: Effects of ozanimod on myelin dynamics and neurodegeneration in patients with relapsingremitting multiple sclerosis: correlation with disease activity, cognition, fatigue,depression and quality of life
summary: Main objective: The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the effects of ozanimod in RRMS patients in limiting the progression of brain neurodegenerative phenomena over the course of 2 years.
conditions: Multiple sclerosis patients in relapse and remission form
